text:
For this election cycle, I just wanted to lean back and have the perfect customized feed instead of the usual 20 browser tabs and constant refreshing. With this dashboard, you can customize the sources, change the layout, see all the odds and results in one window. Everything you need for election night (alcohol not included). It's completely free, with no sign up, no ads, nothing. Enjoy everyone, have a good night.

(BTW, .run domains are severely underrated)
title: Show HN: Election.run – election night in one window
